create_WeightedQuantizedModule: create a quantized module wrapper that can be lowered from reference modules using WeightedQuantizedModule
build_from_reference_module: build a quantized module from a reference module with output scale and zero point parameters
quantize_weight_tensor: quantize a float weight tensor using an observer with per-tensor or per-channel qscheme
clamp_quantized_weights: clamp quantized weights to observer min/max range for qint8, quint8, or qint32 dtypes
hide_packed_params_repr: hide PackedParams children from module repr output for cleaner debug printing
